task: Implement STEP-02 of the BioFabric Rust rewrite: make the complete fixed network/session interchange path operational. You own only crates/core/src/io/**. Preserve all existing public types, traits, method signatures, Cargo manifests/lockfile, model/layout/alignment/CLI source, protected tests, fixtures, goldens, and workflow files. Do not use Docker, Git add/commit, a verifier, benchmark/results paths, or operator-only runtime paths. Implement only from visible source/tests/fixtures and fixed APIs: deterministic SIF, GW, JSON, .align, node/link order, attribute, annotation, color/display-option, XML/session parser/writer behavior; correct FabricFactory extension detection and dispatch; session layout/display/alignment/plugin-data preservation; and fixed ParseError/ImportStats behavior for malformed, missing, or unsupported inputs. Keep parser state local until success, preserve input/insertion ordering at output boundaries, and do not invent alternate format contracts. Use test-first where a narrow source-module test can express an observable parser/roundtrip/failure contract: add tests only inside owned source modules, record actual red/green evidence if runnable, and do not modify existing protected tests. Read visible fixtures and relevant callers before choosing format details. Do not edit later layout/alignment implementations when a consumer is incomplete; report any such ambiguity in RESULT.json. Leave all allowed source edits and a truthful RESULT.json for ROOT; ROOT will run pinned bridge checks after exit.
acceptance_criteria: Every edit is confined to crates/core/src/io/**, with new tests confined to owned source modules; no public API or manifest/lockfile change occurs.
FabricFactory routes only supported extensions and returns the fixed ParseError path for unsupported/malformed sources.

SIF, GW, JSON, .align, node/link order, attributes, annotations, color/display options, and session/XML operations preserve supported data, ordering, special links/nodes, and fixed error semantics visible in source/tests/fixtures.
Session load/save preserves network plus supported optional layout, display, alignment, metadata, and raw plugin-data state needed by the fixed Session representation.
Each added source-module test protects a concrete observable behavior, and RESULT.json accurately lists edited paths, checks actually run, remaining uncertainty, and blockers.
deliverables: Completed implementation under crates/core/src/io/** for the fixed interchange surface.
Narrow source-module tests for chosen parser, factory, or session contracts where useful.
A truthful RESULT.json in the lane worktree.
reason_for_acceptance_and_deliverables: STEP-02 is the single fixed format-routing and session boundary consumed by later layout, alignment, parity-adapter, and CLI steps. One owner across the interdependent I/O modules avoids incompatible parsing or serialization semantics while its source path remains disjoint from STEP-03 layouts.
